coverage_definition: Coverage combines the primary reviewer and three complementary review lenses. A full supplied-text read means the supplied text/extraction was read, not that every theorem was independently reproved or every original PDF page visually inspected.

documents.notes: Read first; full substantive text and relevant/generated link definitions inspected across the review.
Full text, captions, examples, remarks and links covered; concentrated independent checks on §4 and §7.

Full sequential read of lines 1–6159 by the long-record lens, including every catalogue row and Appendices A–F; primary reviewer independently inspected key bridges, quantum passages, lower-bound subtleties and endpoint comparisons.
All 972 lines of the original 19-page preprint extraction read by the primary reviewer.
All fourteen principles assessed individually in reader_principles.md in this return.
Read as objects of review. One narrow method tension survives challenge; several candidate defects were rejected because the rules already cover them.

Integration/fidelity material read. Previous dispositions were checked: full exposition and record dispositions by their lenses; quantum-mechanism and candidate-specific expert dispositions by the primary/quantum reviewers. No claim that every historical review file was read.
Used to check retained-factor/logical-cap wording. Other Lean definitions and links were inspected selectively; implementation proofs and receipt execution were not revalidated.

historical_trace.notes: Full-file searches/indexing plus first 160 lines and selected integration/review spans (including lines 8890–8970 and 9030–9073). The 43,409-line trace was not read sequentially in full and is not the authority for current manuscript wording.
